correctness.rationale: For every n, each one-sided-shift periodic word defines exactly one base point. Its torus return matrix Q diag(1,sign) with Q>=2 has finite kernels of A-I and A+I, of respective orders absolute determinants. The fixed sets of the pillow are their union modulo inversion; intersection equals the inversion-fixed portion. Burnside gives Q^2+sign. Summing all binary words cancels sign corrections and yields D^n. By the published Fatou classification infinity is the sole extra periodic point. Zeta and Möbius inversion follow. The self-contained verifier corroborates 11 modular pillow cases and 2550 symbolic words, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact fixed-point and itinerary-weighted census is a natural missing invariant of the first constructed 3D uniformly quasiregular Cantor-sphere Julia map, with infinitely many Fatou components. The subtle branch-corner correction and sign cancellation yield complete zeta functions; despite connected spherical Julia components the Julia zeta is identical to a full D-symbol shift. This supplies every primitive-period orbit count and clarifies what entropy alone does not determine.
